usedFor: Streak holds sales boxes, and Bolna places a call through “Make a Phone Call” when a “New Box” is created.

bestTemplate.name: “New Box” in Streak, then “Make a Phone Call” in Bolna
bestTemplate.why: A new sales box prompts a call from Bolna, so follow-up starts without anyone dialing.

watchOut: “New Box” runs for every box, so “Make a Phone Call” will ring each new lead unless you filter.
